issue.title: Bank UI e2e invalid-fence: view:nope month note never shows the valid-view error card
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-lt.land while landing epic bob-cli-lt. Not caused by the landing-tale edits (scoped hide, Setup e2e, docs trim): the same four existing-script failures reproduce on clean bob-plugins HEAD 99e3410.

## What fails

`scripts/obsidian-bank-ui-e2e.cjs` records `invalid-fence` as FAIL with empty detail. The case opens `bank/2026-08.md` (`view: nope`) and expects `/valid view|Invalid bob-bank|nope/` in the first card text or `errors`. After a 600 ms sleep the probe sees no card text. The screenshot shows Properties + the August 2026 H1 and no "This bank card needs a valid view" error card.

## Repro

```
xvfb-run -a env BOB_BIN=/home/bryan/.cargo/bin/bob TMPDIR=/tmp/bse2e \
  node scripts/obsidian-bank-ui-e2e.cjs \
  -e /snap/obsidian/current/app/obsidian \
  -o /tmp/bank-ui-e2e-out -r /tmp/bank-ui-e2e-out/report.json
```

Failed identically on the land tree and on a clean worktree of 99e3410 (`feat(bank): add Accounts, Rules, and Checks to the Bank Setup card`).

The product still has the error copy in `241m-plugin-bank-cards.js` ("This bank card needs a valid view" / aria-label "Invalid bob-bank options"). The e2e only sleeps 600 ms and reads `invalid.cards[0]`.

## CI failure

- **Node:** `scripts/obsidian-bank-ui-e2e.cjs invalid-fence`
